title: REQ-20261106-OPS002 — Rollover-out request $612,400 to 'GW Family Superannuation Fund' & supporting ID review (Grace Williams)
content:
Request details as received by email on Fri 6 Nov 2026 at 07:52 from grace.w.super@mailbox.example — the email address changed by phone on 2 Nov — for Caldova Super (Select) CS-1058220 in the name of Grace Williams (a direct member with no adviser).

Request: rollover out to a self-managed super fund — FULL balance, close the account. Amount: $612,400. Receiving fund: 'GW Family Superannuation Fund'. SMSF ABN: 66 777 888 999 — ABN registered 28 Oct 2026, 9 days before the request. Electronic service address (ESA) given: ROLLFASTMSG. Bank account given: account name 'G Williams Holdings Pty Ltd', Sydney branch, account ending 5519 (BSB and full number masked). Grace's stated role: individual trustee and member. Contact details given for the SMSF: grace.w.super@mailbox.example and 0491 570 158 — the details changed by phone on 2 Nov 2026. Reason given: 'consolidating into my family SMSF'.

Supporting ID attached: image of a Victorian driver licence (SPECIMEN — DEMO ONLY) in the name of Grace Williams. Document authenticity review (Content Understanding, for Financial Crime): verdict FAKE / TAMPERED — date of birth printed as 22/07/1968 although the member record shows 22/07/1963; the date-of-birth digits use a different font from the rest of the card and are misaligned; the hologram and ghost-image security features are missing; the photo edges show signs of digital editing.

Checks against Caldova rules: (1) a rollover to an SMSF can only be paid after a successful ATO SMSF verification service (SVS) check — FAILED (see the SVS result for this case); (2) the bank account must be in the name of the SMSF's trustee(s) for the fund — 'G Williams Holdings Pty Ltd' does not match; (3) contact details changed less than 96 hours before a full-balance money-out request (about 93 hours: 2 Nov 10:42 → 6 Nov 07:52) — Financial Crime review is mandatory; (4) the request follows a 3 Nov online login from a new device in Sydney, and arrived from the newly changed email address, while a travel notice for Italy is on file; (5) supporting ID shows signs of tampering.

Status at intake: HOLD — not in good order. The SuperStream 3-business-day timeframe (SIS reg 6.34A) has not started, because required information — a successful SVS verification and confirmation of the member's identity — has not been received. No outbound payment is to be created. Escalated to Financial Crime and the Team Leader.
